title: lupinus longifolius
intro: Lupinus longifolius, commonly known as the bigleaf lupine, is a perennial flowering plant that belongs to the legume family. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including inflammation and digestive issues, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Lupinus longifolius include its ability to reduce oxidative stress and its potential to act as an antimicrobial agent. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
